title: Have config-authored env changes alter only Launch identity (ga-i91hrn)
body:
## Summary

- add `runtime.Config.OperatorEnv` as a dedicated identity input for operator-authored configuration environment values
- hash it deterministically into Core and Launch identity, while leaving Provision identity unchanged
- advance the fingerprint version to v6 and rebaseline both pinned golden surfaces
- add the PASS release gate at `release-gates/ga-s2tnk7-operator-env-launch-identity-gate.md`

## Work records

- Build: `ga-i91hrn`
- Review: `ga-is95n2` — PASS on exact source `4b8481da16ce49637211d0a8f6188379504a4dd4`
- Deploy: `ga-s2tnk7` — PASS

## Test plan

- `make test-local-full-parallel`: 38/40 jobs passed; the two raw failures occurred during external `bd init` against outdated shared-server schemas before candidate code could run and are tracked by pre-existing `ga-esyijp`
- all eight diff-owned tests passed in the authoritative verbose run
- `make build`, `make fmt-check vet`, `make test-ci-policy`, boundary checks, and `make test-native-doltlite-beads`: PASS
- `make lint`: only the pre-existing ignored dashboard `node_modules/flatted` condition tracked by `ga-bvixfw`
- normal push hook: all 10 fast jobs passed

Merge authority remains with the mayor or merge processor; the deployer has not merged this PR.
